purpose: Teach: 前作/反復/ハードル/ベタ/アンコール/アウトドア/大晦日/ぶどう

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、本気で、絶対、好きなアニメの、絶対、前作、絶対、見たいよ
lines.en: Mom, I really, really want to see the first season of that anime I love.
lines.style: Urgent, breathless intensity. Leans forward. The repetition of 「絶対」 becomes physical — hands gesturing. Completely sincere, no performance. Childlike conviction that this matters most in the world right now.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、漢字、絶対、反復、絶対、練習、絶対、続けてね
lines.en: Sho, you really need to keep practicing your kanji — seriously, over and over.
lines.style: Firm but not unkind. Measured pace. The mother-tone that says *I see what you're doing, and also I'm not budging*. Quiet authority, no edge.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが、本気で、絶対、ぼくの、絶対、ハードル、絶対、上げすぎだよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad's seriously setting the bar way too high for me.
lines.style: Small whine underneath real frustration. Slight pitch rise on 「上げすぎだよ」. Not throwing a tantrum — genuinely bewildered that the standard is so far above him. Testing if Mom will agree.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さん、本気で、絶対、ベタ、絶対、なお話、絶対、好きなのよね
lines.en: Sho, your dad really does love those clichéd story types, doesn't he.
lines.style: Knowing, almost amused realization. Not criticism — affection disguised as observation. Warm exhalation, like she's seen this about him a hundred times. Maternal understanding.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、テレビで、本気で、絶対、アンコール、絶対、シーン、絶対、流れたよ
lines.en: Mom, the TV showed that encore scene and I totally saw it!
lines.style: Bright, urgent excitement. Rapid, as if the words can barely keep up with what he wants to say. Light, almost bouncing. Pride in having witnessed something he knows Dad would like.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと、本気で、絶対、アウトドア、絶対、計画してるわよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad and I are actually planning an outdoor trip together.
lines.style: Gentle reveal, like she's sharing something tender. Slower pace on the announcement. Warm, almost conspiratorial — she knows this will land well with him. Soft smile underneath the words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、大晦日、絶対、お年玉、絶対、楽しみだよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm really looking forward to New Year's money!
lines.style: Pure childish delight. Bright, quick attack. Guileless — this is happiness unfiltered. No self-consciousness, just joy at anticipation.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、ぶどう、絶対、お買いになる?本気で
lines.en: Sho, are you seriously going to buy grapes?
lines.style: Gentle curiosity with a thread of amusement. Warmer, slightly slower. The kind of question a mother asks when she's delighted by her child's specific wants. Close, intimate attention.
